trigger: HUD corner notification. Environmental; one per outdoor sleep day.
draft_prose: Kynareth's road is good to you today.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; one per qualifying event.
draft_prose: Mara and Stendarr have noted what you spared.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; one per Hall-of-the-Dead or anti-necromancy beat.
draft_prose: The order of the dead is kept.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; costly-faithful only.
draft_prose: The contradiction holds. Talos hears even here.

trigger: MessageBox. High-cost only; per-event cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Talos Inside the Nine" Body: "You carried both my name and theirs, and would not put me down. Walk on."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on first transformation as Nord.
draft_prose: Title: "Hircine's Pull" Body: "The beast is in the Companions' gift, but it stands against Shor's hall. Your seat on the bridge weakens while the hunt holds."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on werewolf cure completion.
draft_prose: Title: "The Bridge Holds Again" Body: "The hunt is set down. Hircine's hold is broken, and your seat on the bridge holds firm once more. Shor's hall will name you when the day comes. Tsun marks that you ran with the beast, and does not forget."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on becoming vampire.
draft_prose: Title: "Sovngarde Closes" Body: "Molag Bal's shadow has fallen across you. Sovngarde will not name you while you carry his thirst. Cure the curse, and even then the scar remains."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on cure completion.
draft_prose: Title: "The Door Stands Ajar" Body: "The thirst is gone. The bridge is open again. But Tsun has seen what walked into the dark, and that is not forgotten."

trigger: Dialogue topic; Kyne Devoted; one priest archetype.
draft_prose: "I sleep where Kyne sleeps. I hunt where she hunts."

trigger: Dialogue topic; Talos Devoted, hidden shrine context.
draft_prose: "The old breath is mine to carry. Tell me what is needed."

trigger: Dialogue topic; Arkay Devoted at any Hall of the Dead.
draft_prose: "I keep the rites. What is owed the dead here?"
